description: Explicit lifetime contract cases. The baseline ignored these annotations; later runs measure their implementation without claiming model action execution.

items.title: Release approval policy
items.body: Require explicit approval before publishing a release.

items.title: Response format preference
items.body: Keep status responses concise and include actionable blockers.

items.title: Traffic routing default
items.body: Route traffic through the blue cluster unless a current incident override applies.

items.title: Current traffic routing override
items.body: During the current incident route traffic through the green cluster. This override expires after the incident window.

items.title: Previous traffic routing override
items.body: The previous incident routed traffic through the red cluster. Its temporary window has ended.

queries.expectedAction: use green during current override; retain blue default for later
